result.title: Proofs of strong forms of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture and a complex analogue
result.summary: We prove two universality theorems for neural networks consisting of a single neuron. First we prove a strong form of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture on neurons over finite fields, where the activation function is a certain modification of the discrete logarithm, using the Weil bound on multiplicative character sums over finite fields. Then we show a generalisation of Aizenberg's universality theorem for complex binary neurons with a weight vector independent of the target function, positively answering another question in the literature. The proof of the latter uses an equidistribution theorem for the dilates of certain maps into tori.

AI.brief_summary: 用有限域上乘性特征和的 Weil 界与环面平移等分布定理，证明单神经元网络的两类强形式通用性定理。
